title: Forward Industries, RockawayX back OnRe to build onchain reinsurance on Solana
summary: Investors back a model that moves insurance risk and capital flows onto blockchain rails, as onchain reinsurance looks to attract institutional participation.

title: Ripple CEO says market structure bill not a ‘done deal,’ despite stablecoin compromise
summary: Brad Garlinghouse addressed attendees at a Tuesday crypto conference on the progress of the CLARITY Act after US lawmakers announced a compromise on stablecoin yield that could advance the legislation.

title: Prophet launches AI-powered prediction market with live $10,000 trading tranche
summary: Prophet, an AI-native prediction market platform, has launched its first live trading tranche, introducing a system where an AI model acts as the counterparty to user trades using real capital.

title: Bitcoin short liquidations push BTC to multi-month highs: Is $90K next?
summary: Short liquidations and rising open interest may be signs of the bulls’ plan to push the Bitcoin price closer to $90,000.

title: Crypto PAC spends $500K in support of Indiana candidate ahead of primary
summary: Days before an Indiana primary, the Defend American Jobs PAC reported spending about $514,000 on media in support of a Republican House member running for reelection in the state‘s 4th Congressional District.

title: Tennessee Bankers Association names Stablecore as preferred digital asset provider
summary: Regional lenders gain access to infrastructure for stablecoins, tokenized deposits and crypto-backed lending without building systems in-house, signaling wider bank adoption.

title: Crypto Fear and Greed Index turns neutral for first time since January: Is $100K BTC next?
summary: Improving investor confidence supports Bitcoin’s hold on $80,000, as the Crypto Fear and Greed Index exited the “Extreme Fear” zone and now reads “neutral.” Are the bulls back in control?

title: US prosecutors ask for leniency for ex-Celsius exec, citing cooperation
summary: While Roni Cohen-Pavon’s lawyers have asked for time served, US Attorney Jay Clayton was unspecific in the federal government’s recommendation, requesting the judge defer to sentencing guidelines.

title: Bernstein cites $4T tokenized credit opportunity for Figure Technology stock
summary: Bernstein points to Figure’s expansion beyond home equity lending into blockchain-based credit, as tokenization begins to scale across broader loan markets.

title: XRP price copies 2025 chart fractal that last time sparked 66% gains
summary: XRP price broke out of a multi-month bull flag, while other chart technicals are also supporting more upside in the near term.
